issue: Discovery sweep (2026-06) found NO new or revived LNG terminal candidate in Uruguay. GNL Del Plata FSRU (Punta Sayago, sponsor Gas Sayago SA / ANCAP+UTE JV) remains the only Uruguayan LNG terminal in GEM and is correctly marked cancelled: Gas Sayago SA was put into liquidation by the Chamber of Deputies and the port concession was unilaterally rescinded by ANP in Dec 2019; no development activity since ~2015. Uruguay's current (2025-2026) gas-supply strategy is explicitly PIPELINE-based, not LNG: Argentine Vaca Muerta gas already flows via the existing Cruz del Sur pipeline (Punta Lara -> Colonia/Montevideo), and on 7 May 2026 President Yamandu Orsi ordered a technical advisory group to evaluate the proposed 'Gas Oriental' cross-border pipeline (Argentina/Vaca Muerta -> through Uruguay -> southern Brazil). No FSRU charter or deployment to Uruguay was found. Uruguay's prominent green hydrogen / green ammonia projects (Paysandu H2V US$4bn e-fuels plant; offshore green-hydrogen concession) are out of GEM LNG-terminal scope (NH3/LH2 read-only) and are NOT LNG terminals.
suggested_action: No GEM action needed. Keep GNL Del Plata FSRU as cancelled. Re-check Uruguay if a regasification/FSRU tender re-emerges, but current signal points away from LNG (pipeline integration with Argentina/Brazil). Re-check date ~12 months.
